header.title: How to Test a Dryer Motor
header.description: This guide provides instructions on how to diagnose a faulty dryer motor by performing a series of tests, including checking for obstructions and manually rotating the motor shaft.

steps.description: Disconnect the power supply to the dryer by unplugging it or turning off the circuit breaker.
The dryer needs to be turned on its side to access the motor.
Remove the rubber belt from the dryer motor using hands or a screwdriver.
actions: remove the rubber belt from the motor

steps.description: Inspect the blower fan housing for any visible obstructions and remove them if found.
actions: Look inside the housing for the blower fan.
If there are any obvious obstructions, remove them.

steps.description: Manually rotate the motor shaft to check for grinding or resistance, and then test the motor's operation with and without the belt.
actions: manually rotate the shaft of the motor
check if the shaft is grinding or hard to turn
run the motor without the belt on
check if the motor runs fine without the belt
